groups.algorithm: Stable prefix minimum along one axis, with a value and int64 prefix index per element.
alternatives: Whole-row scan with buffered contiguous GM movement retains ownership and dependency order.
Hierarchical cross-core prefix scan can expose long-single-row parallelism but needs carry propagation, extra launches and tie/NaN proof; defer until evidence warrants.
groups.ownership: Disjoint output ownership; no cross-core writes to another task output.
groups.reduction: Sequential dependency within a prefix sequence only
groups.synchronization: Per-core input/compute/output dependencies; no cross-core synchronization.
groups.task_partition: Whole independent sequences or groups of 32 adjacent strided sequences; each owner scans the complete axis in order.
groups.workspace_formula: 0 global intermediate; any new cross-core reduction or carry pass requires revised plan.
